description.narrative: AfricInvest SME Fund targets investments in growth companies in various sectors in Africa. Swedfund's investment provides access to equity and promotes thegrowth of small and medium-sized enterprises in countries where access to capital is limited. The investment contributes to private sector development and job creation. Swedfund's investment contributes to sector and market development by contributing to local economic growth and sustainable private sector development. Furthermore, the investment is expected to contribute to job creation and other income-generating opportunities locally. The investment contributes to increasing women's economic empowerment by promoting women as leaders, as workers and through increased access to capital.
